chunks: And from them, may Allah have mercy on them, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Hamdan ibn Ishaq, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) or a man narrated to me from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) — the doubt is from 'Ali — saying, and he mentioned like the hadith of Ayub ibn Nuḥ, the hadith of the pulpit.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْمِنْبَرِ: The pulpit (referring to the status or location associated with the Imams)

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith of the pulpit mentioned in Kamil al-Ziyarat?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) links the virtues of Imam al-Rida (a.s.) to the established tradition of the 'pulpit' (al-manbar), a symbol of Imamate authority and spiritual station often associated with the Prophet’s pulpit or the Imams' graves. By citing this parallel, the text underscores the continuity of divine leadership and the specific reward for performing Ziyarah to Imam al-Rida in Tus, reinforcing his status as a successor in the line of the Twelve Imams.
